as_told.title: Hugh Everett worked for the Pentagon on nuclear game theory

plain: The physicist Hugh Everett, who came up with the "many worlds" theory (the idea that every possible outcome plays out in its own separate universe), is said to have gone on to work for the Pentagon, the US Department of Defense, on game theory for the American nuclear weapons programme. Michels tells this himself in two episodes, without naming a source, and also mentions the physicists John Wheeler and Bryce DeWitt alongside Everett. He brings it up to show how closely the deepest ideas in physics were tied to military work.
